chosen.title: feet in high heels of a woman walking down steps
chosen.why: Outdoor stone steps in bright daylight, low side angle on feet only, continuous descent 0-10s with steady step rhythm; low-saturation stone/sky palette. Only miss: high heels read slightly dressier than a soft morning POV.

alternates.why: Frontal knee-down walking shot, sneakers, bright daylight sidewalk, no face; not stairs (flat street) so only a fallback if stairs are dropped.

notes: Searched: walking down stairs feet, stairs, walking down steps, feet walking, legs stairs, staircase, going down stairs. Mixkit has almost no feet-only outdoor stair descents. Rejected: 770 (face visible, indoor black stair), 40755 (athletic man, face, stadium), 1297/22223/28823 (faces or ascending). 35987 source is 720p (Mixkit max for this clip). Its descent pauses on a landing at ~11-12.5s, so keep the cut inside 0-10s; 1.4-4.6s window recommended.
